title: Thoughts on Missions

authorInfo.bio: Sheldon Dibble (1809–1845) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Thoughts on Missions" by Sheldon Dibble is a theological text written in the mid-19th century. The book addresses the urgent call for missionary work among the heathen, emphasizing the moral responsibilities of Christians to spread the Gospel worldwide.
